Chapter 7068: Disastrous

Chapter 7068: Disastrous

“Do you think destroying this ocean is akin to destroying us? You haven’t seen our true depths.” Zhao Dachui said.

“Feel free to show me.” Li Qiye smiled.

Listeners exchanged glances, wondering what the celestial immortals had up their sleeves.

The four seemingly hesitated and didn’t respond.

“Now’s the time.” Li Qiye repeated.

The four still didn’t answer.

“Oh, I forgot, you’re just puppets now, not actually alive. Call your master then.” Li Qiye waved dismissively.

“You!” They glared hatefully at him.

“Am I wrong? Call your master before I destroy this ocean and it is too late.” Li Qiye said.

They trembled with rage, recalling when they were imperious and alive. They feared no one and even tried to kill the high heaven. Unfortunately, the truth was that they were dead and only had life latched onto the corpses.

This feeling of helplessness was humiliating and infuriating, especially when Li Qiye pointed it out.

“Only Heavenfall and Dusk can do something like this.” An immortal said.

“Dusk is dead, Heavenfall lost his body. They’re not the ones controlling them.” A golden immortal said.

“Don’t forget about Hidden Immortal and Octopus.” Heaven’s Equal spoke.

“You’re right, are they hiding in this ocean?” The golden immortal responded.

“Who knows? We might be able to spot Octopus since that would be a big occasion. However, Hidden Immortal can stand next to you and be entirely undetected.” Heaven’s Equal said.

“Really?” Listeners immediately looked around and became cautious, keeping a distance with everyone.

“No one can dominate celestial immortals outside of Octopus and Hidden Immortal.” Someone commented.

Others nearby agreed because these were prideful beings. Only Octopus and Hidden Immortal were stronger than them.

“I am finally here today, no one will be able to escape or hide.” Li Qiye smiled.

He didn’t take action but everyone suddenly felt themselves sinking.

“Boom!” They heard a sound striking their soul, not through their ears. Some immortals nearly dropped to the ground while overlords couldn’t move an inch.

Li Qiye’s body became increasingly heavier. His location began twisting; the ocean of tribulation itself concave downward with Li Qiye at the center.

It felt threatened and sent the tribulations ferociously at him. However, they stopped before touching him, unable to handle the sheer gravity surrounding him.

“What?!” Zhao Dachui and the others became alarmed since the crumbling of the ocean could spell an end to them. This was nothing short of disastrous.
